criteria.criterion: A new test in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs (using with_free_space and simulated_free) has a writer build whose size takes simulated free disk below min_free_gb. The job is not held for disk, the build directory is removed first, and the checks run to a verdict. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` and check that it passes.
criteria.evidence: The new test `low_disk_from_the_writer_build_is_cleared_before_the_checks_gate_so_the_job_is_not_held` uses `with_free_space(low_once_built)`, which reports 3 GB while `target/produce` exists, and a Producer script that plants `target/produce/debug/big`. It asserts the job finishes as Landed, the build directory is gone, the 'disk       removed the producer's build directory' line comes before the 'checks     ' line, and no 'held       ' line appears. My run of `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` printed 'ok' for it (151 passed, 0 failed). Reading the code, on the base the up-front gate would run while `target/produce` still exists, find 3 GB, and hold the job, so the test would fail there.

criteria.criterion: A new test with a GitHub origin and a green CI run for the candidate, with free disk below min_free_gb, shows the checks stage does not hold for low disk and prints the 'ci   checks reused' line. A companion case with no usable CI result shows the disk gate still holds the job before the local check run. Run `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` and check that both pass.
criteria.evidence: `low_disk_with_a_green_ci_run_does_not_hold_the_checks_stage` sets a GitHub origin and installs a fake gh (`CiReplies::Green`) plus `EarlyFake`. It asserts the job lands, a 'ci         checks reused from' line appears, no 'held       ' line appears, the fake gh was asked, and one CI-branch push was recorded. There are two companion tests. `low_disk_with_no_ci_result_holds_before_the_local_run_and_a_retry_with_space_runs_the_checks` has no origin. `low_disk_with_a_github_origin_and_no_ci_run_holds_before_the_local_run` has an origin and a gh answer of `workflow_runs: []`. Both assert a LowDisk hold (3 GB free, 10 GB required), no 'checks     ' line, the build removed before the 'held' line, the hold recorded, and the job Dispatched with no outcome. Both then check that a retry with space lands. All three passed in my run.

criteria.criterion: In crates/athena-core/src/run/mod.rs check_and_verify, the up-front disk_gate call before the checks is gone. free_producer_build runs before any disk_gate in the checks stage, and the gate is called only on the local-run path. Check by reading the diff.
criteria.evidence: The diff removes the `if recorded_checks.is_none() && let Some(low) = self.disk_gate(...)` block before `push_ci_branch`. `free_producer_build` is still called at mod.rs:1458 when the Checks stage starts. Grep for `disk_gate(` shows the only new call at checks.rs:34, inside `SnapExec::exec` behind a `gated` once-flag. Per routing.rs:180, `exec` is called only for a check that actually runs, after skips and CI reuse. A LowDisk error is downcast in `check_and_verify`, the verify snapshot is removed, and `hold_for_disk` is called.

findings.summary: A job held at the checks gate now pushes its CI branch and opens its early PR before the hold. The old gate ran before both.
findings.evidence: The gate now runs inside the routed checks, after `push_ci_branch`, `early_pr` and `verifier_snapshot`. The hold path removes the verify snapshot. `finish_dispatched` deletes the CI branch on any result (mod.rs:992-995), but the early PR stays open while the job is held. This follows from narrowing the gate to the local-run path, which the reading asks for, so it is not a defect. It is worth knowing about.

summary: I recommend a pass. The change fixes the false disk hold where the request said it starts. The old code checked free disk in `check_and_verify` before the job's own writer build was removed and before the CI result was read. The new code removes that check and runs the existing `disk_gate` once inside `SnapExec::exec`, just before the first check that runs locally. `free_producer_build` already runs earlier in the Checks stage, so the job's own build is gone by then. A CI result that stands in for the checks never reaches the gate. I ran `cargo test -p athena-cli --test drain` in this snapshot and all 151 tests passed. Four are new: the writer-build case, a green-CI case, and two cases with no usable CI result. The existing low-disk hold tests also passed. Reading the code, the new tests would fail on the base, because the old early gate saw the planted `target/produce` directory, found 3 GB free and held the job. The dispatch gate (mod.rs:782), the producer gate (mod.rs:1344) and verification.rs are unchanged. The CHANGELOG and docs/architecture.md entries match the code. There are three minor findings and no blockers: two test-seam files outside the deliverables list, a held job now pushes its CI branch and opens its early PR before the hold, and two doc lines are left unwrapped.
